definitions.explanation: Half of a day — either a morning or an afternoon, or simply a stretch of roughly four to six hours.

examples.japanese: {半日|はんにち}⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took half a day off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{半日|はんにち}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The cleaning took a whole half day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧{半日|はんにち}⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I joined a half-day tour that goes around only in the morning.

notes:
Can mean a morning or an afternoon specifically, or just a span of about half a day's time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半日|はんにち}⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to take half a day
- {半日|はんにち}⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧: a half-day off
- {半日|はんにち}⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧: half-day course or tour

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧: a whole day
- ⟦{半月|はんつき}→半月：15662_hantsuki⟧: half a month

Also read {半日|はんじつ} in some compounds, but はんにち is the everyday reading.
